acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: Next.js routing https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/routing , React Router file route conventions https://reactrouter.com/how-to/file-route-conventions , SvelteKit https://svelte.dev/docs/kit/routing , Nuxt pages https://nuxt.com/docs/guide/directory-structure/pages .

Gap: AMAP-V0 reads only object/DSL dialects (AMAP-V0-002 ui-router-states, AMAP-V0-040..048 rails-routes and react-router on w5-appmap-a). The dominant modern pattern derives routes from directory structure, which no dialect reads.

Proposal: deterministic path-to-route derivation from the pinned tree: dynamic segments, catch-alls, route groups, parallel/intercepting routes, layouts as shared template anchors. Convention overrides found in config stay UNKNOWN. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: appmap: file-system route dialects (Next.js app/pages, React Router v7/Remix flat routes, SvelteKit, Nuxt)
